glossary_caveats: TREE->wood/SOIL->stone/DARK->darkness are label projections. GLORY->flash and ILLUSION->dream are tentative comparison vocabulary, not proof of effect equivalence.
Legacy subvalue/INCREASE_ATK/ADD_ATTRIBUTE and self-cursetag roles are projected for comparison, not asserted operationally equal.

An absent official abilityValue=0 does not mean a zero effect. Current removeItems count3 and other handler constants are not catalog fields; do not turn metadata differences into behavioral conclusions.
role_only candidates can differ in every power/value/cost/weight. Unique candidate does not prove historical identity.
No positional/numeric-ID matching, name invention or unsupported effect removal. Unknown identity is retained explicitly.
